svg.title: A uniform crop and a mixed crop during an outbreak
svg.desc: Two fields of 45 plants during a fungal outbreak. Uniform planting: every plant is the same genotype, a clone, and all 45 are infected. Mixed planting: four genotypes are planted in a scattered mix, and three of them carry alleles that resist this strain of the fungus; 5 of the 45 plants, all of the susceptible genotype, are infected. In the mixed field, spores often land on plants they cannot infect, so the outbreak spreads less.
